sequenceTutorial.descriptionText: Fuel — increases the distance you can travel.
Body — strengthens and protects the car from damage.
Turret — adds firepower to destroy obstacles and enemies.
Tires — improve grip and stability on difficult roads.
Donate — support the game and get bonuses.
Play — start the race and try to drive as far as possible.
Map — unlock new locations and return to completed levels at any time.
Upgrade Garage — level up your car to the max.
